Crypto-agility architecture makes the next migration a configuration event.
Hybrid key establishment bridges the transition without waiting for perfection.
Where it breaks in practice: spectacle: formulations chosen for the press release rather than the problem class, benchmarked against weak classical baselines that do not survive review.
The serious opposition goes: the formulation-first thesis can hide behind rigor while the classical baseline quietly improves. Benchmarks are re-run on a schedule, not once.
The practice, as we run it

In delivery, this thesis becomes a specific discipline: we treat advanced compute as a tool with a contract — bounded problem classes, measured speedups, and a classical baseline the CFO can read. Every program in the Quantum & Advanced Compute domain carries the same obligations — a signed baseline, named gate criteria, and evidence generated by running the system rather than preparing for a meeting.
